thread:
jamie: quick question — can we add inflight experiment/variant tags on rerank requests so the console rollouts + telemetry can tie latency and score distributions to variants? thinking a header + runtime copy rather than stuffing in the result payload

leo: yes — we've kicked this around. idea was X-RW-Variant header. pros: non-breaking, easy for SDK to set. cons: some proxies strip custom headers and cache keying changes. also telemetry cost if we tag every request.

sara: alternative: add routing_metadata top-level field to rerank envelope, e.g. `
{
  "routing_metadata": { "experiment": "rescorer_v2", "bucket": "A" }
}
` That survives through the stack and is explicit. downside = payload change for all clients.

micah: payload change is breaking for external clients. header approach is safer for gradual rollout. we can have ingress copy header -> request context so runtime + tracing can see it.

jamie: header + copy sounds fine. couple followups: (1) backpressure/quotas — if a variant increases fanout or latency we need to be able to throttle or route to dedicated capacity; (2) console UX needs to show variant breakdown for latency/score histograms and allow filtering.

leo: agreed on both. proposal: 1) adopt `X-RW-Variant` and optional `X-RW-Variant-Seed` headers. 2) ingress copies them into internal request metadata and strips headers before handing request to model (must never leak experiment names into model input). 3) runtime tags traces/metrics with variant label. 4) add lightweight per-variant histograms (last N mins) for score distributions.

sara: minor addition: default to `control` when header missing so dashboards don't have huge "unknown" bucket. and SDKs should expose helper to set header for experiments.

micah: note about quotas: we should not change billing, but the console should surface per-variant token/score unit consumption. later we can add variant-aware soft quotas or autoscale suggestions if cost > baseline.

jamie: good. telemetry sampling — we probably don't need 100% detailed payloads. store summaries: percentiles and small sketch for scores. full-request sampling at 0.5% for debugging.

leo: one more security/privacy point: ensure ingress strips headers for any cross-customer routing. also redact variant names from logs unless flagged.

ops-bot: created ticket RW-ENG-1482 "rerank variant telemetry + header ingress" and rule PRD-422 for rollout variance alert. Link: https://redwood.example/tickets/RW-ENG-1482

deploy-bot: FYI console change required for canary control: API shape suggestion:
POST /routes/{route_id}/rollouts
Body: { "variant": "rescorer_v2", "percent": 10, "start_at": "2026-04-01T10:00:00Z" }

jamie: OK actionable checklist:
- infra/ingress: copy X-RW-Variant -> internal metadata, strip before model, redact in logs
- runtime: add variant tag to traces/metrics and per-variant histograms
- console: rollout knob + variant filter + per-variant telemetry panels
- SDK/docs: header helpers & examples (python/js/curl)
- ops: alert for score distribution drift during rollouts

sara: +1. I'll own docs & SDK examples. micah can you open the RFC for ingress change?

micah: yep will draft RFC and prototype ingress patch this week, assign tasks in RW-ENG-1482.

leo: timeline ask from product: P0 for enterprise canary flow. can we target next sprint for infra + runtime tagging and console follow-up?

jamie: let's aim for infra/runtime in next sprint, console in the sprint after. if enterprise needs urgent canaries we can patch console with a simple variant toggle linked to header at first.

micah: opening PR: https://redwood.example/pulls/5555 (WIP) — will add tests for header copy + strip.

jamie: thanks everyone. we'll sync in standup if there are blockers. :thumbsup:
